event.title: Kirsten Davies Appointed as New National Cyber Director Amid Service Outages
event.canonical_title: Kirsten Davies Appointed as New National Cyber Director Amid Service Outages
event.summary: The White House has appointed Kirsten Davies as the new national cyber director following a series of widespread service outages that disrupted daily life and caused concern among Americans. This move aims to strengthen the nation's cybersecurity response.

timeline.title: FIFA Reports Cyberattack Targeting Personal and Business Information
timeline.summary: FIFA has confirmed that it was the target of a cyberattack that accessed a limited set of personal and business information. The attack comes at a challenging time for the organization and its president, Gianni Infantino. The hacking group responsible for the breach is identified as the 'Handsome Boy Hacking Club.'
key_facts: FIFA was targeted in a cyberattack.
The attack accessed a limited set of personal and business information.
The hacking group involved is called the 'Handsome Boy Hacking Club.'
